name: ax-watchdog
description: Watch the AX automations and channels, heal what it can, and push an alert

stale_hours.description: A channel with no upload for longer than this is reported stale.

cooldown_hours.description: Do not repeat the same alert within this many hours.

ntfy_topic.description: ntfy.sh topic to push alerts to. Empty disables push.

heal.description: Re-enable automations the platform auto-paused after repeated failures.
